review_notes: 'ey-zeh is fused under rule 30 in both clauses, headed on 'ey, the morpheme carrying the wh-lexeme (rule 23). The competing reading, which this verse first carried, aligns 'ey alone to Where is and marks zeh unrepresented under rule 22; the corpus records six 'ey-zeh units (JER.6.16, 1KI.13.12, ISA.66.1 twice, ECC.11.6, 1KI.22.24) and fuses in all of them, and JER.6.16's note weighs and rejects the split.
The supplied copula is joins the fused unit rather than defeating rule 30's condition, exactly as that rule states for li-pney rendered was before, and as JER.6.16 reads the same compound.
of light could instead be folded into the nominalized verb's unit; rule 33 gives the supplied preposition to the bare nominal it stands before.
